msu-tcell-lymphoma.identity: MSU randomized CHOP vs LOPP in confirmed peripheral T-cell lymphoma; exact AVMA VCT23005625 still Recruiting.
msu-tcell-lymphoma.recruitment_sites: Current MSU oncology roster links the invitation; MSU Veterinary Medical Center in East Lansing, with referrals/owner calls welcomed. Nearby states and Canada are referral areas, not sites.
msu-tcell-lymphoma.eligibility: Confirmed peripheral T-cell lymphoma; indolent T-zone and cutaneous excluded; no prior lymphoma chemotherapy or radiation. Up to ten days of steroids only by clinician decision. Adequate labs; no dilated cardiomyopathy, ventricular arrhythmia or liver failure.
msu-tcell-lymphoma.funding: Owner pays initial visit and most bloodwork/drugs; rechecks and first doxorubicin or lomustine dose/admin/bloodwork covered. Approximately $250 diagnostic credit after completion/progression.

msu-mct-steroids.identity: MSU prospective neoadjuvant prednisone response/timing study with mandatory surgical resection around day 14.
msu-mct-steroids.recruitment_sites: MSU oncology roster and individual current invitation; in-person MSU checks days 7 and 14, then MSU soft-tissue surgery.
msu-mct-steroids.eligibility: Cytology/histology-confirmed cutaneous trunk MCT above elbow/knee, 2–6 cm; no metastasis; ≥7-day washout anticancer/steroids and ≥5-day NSAID washout. Anesthesia fitness, survival ≥4 weeks with treatment and no diabetes/incompatible systemic illness.
msu-mct-steroids.funding: Up to 50% of surgical and histopathology fees, study drugs and calipers covered; initial consult/eligibility diagnostics and additional surgery owner-paid.

csu-glioma-verdinexor-only-2026.identity: CSU IACUC 6276 / StudyPages 836628: oral verdinexor twice weekly, no CAR-T and no study surgery.
csu-glioma-verdinexor-only-2026.recruitment_sites: Current CSU gallery object 23714, Active - Recruiting; one named Fort Collins site, 300 W Drake Rd; public protocol is active and not snoozed.
csu-glioma-verdinexor-only-2026.eligibility: Dogs at least 10 kg, MRI-confirmed brain tumor, otherwise healthy, no prior chemotherapy or radiotherapy for this tumor. Regular neurological examinations and MRI follow-up.
csu-glioma-verdinexor-only-2026.funding: Institution lists a one-time $700 payment at enrollment for chemotherapy. Study covers exams, bloodwork and recheck MRIs. It does not say chemotherapy is separately free.
